title: a pixel mod
description: this mod adds rgb one color lamps and RGB lamps
body:
a pixel mod adds pixels to minecraft
# Single-color pixels
these pixels work like regular redstone lamps, but they only emit red, green, or blue light.

# RGB pixel
this pixel has a special color mechanic. At levels 1 to 5, it emits red light. At levels 5 to 10, it emits green light. At levels 10 to 15, it emits blue light.
